c094.title: Concert night
c094.story: Anna and Max go to a [[concert]] tonight. It is at the new [[arena]] in Kyiv. All the tickets are [[sold out]]. But Max has two premium tickets! The band starts with a long [[intro]]. Then they play a song from the new [[album]]. The singer has very strong [[vocals|vocal]]. A happy [[groupie]] sings every word. Anna sees the [[tour manager]] near the stage. At the end, Max buys [[merch]] for his sister. She works in [[merchandising]] at a clothing store. Anna says, "I love a good [[live show]]!"

c095.title: A summer music festival
c095.story: In July, Anna and Max go to a summer music [[festival]]. Max just calls it "the [[fest]]." The [[lineup]] has something for everyone. There is [[hip-hop]], [[rap]], [[R&B]], [[reggae]] and electro. First, a young [[rapper]] does a [[freestyle]] with the [[MC]]. The crowd shouts and claps to the beat. Anna does not know any of the songs. But by the evening, she has five new favorites. At night, the park feels like a big [[fiesta]], with dancing everywhere. On the way home, Anna plays her new songs on her phone.

c097.title: A night at the opera
c097.story: Grandma Halyna buys two tickets to the [[opera]] for Anna's birthday. Before the show, a string [[quartet]] plays a gentle [[sonata]] in the big hall. In the lobby, a small jazz [[trio]] plays for the people waiting. Grandma jokes that she and Anna are a funny [[duo]], like on TV. The story is about a sad [[phantom]] who lives under an old theater. A young [[soprano]] steps forward and sings a beautiful [[aria]] about love. It is a [[solo]], so she stands alone in the bright light. Then a [[tenor]] answers her, and they sing a [[duet]] with warm voices. The [[maestro]] smiles and leads the whole [[ensemble]] into the final song. At the end, Anna claps so hard that her hands hurt. "Next year, I'm buying the tickets," she tells Grandma.

c098.title: Taras's music lesson
c098.story: Taras plays in the school band. Today his teacher sings two notes, [[fa]] and [[la]]. "The space between two notes is an [[interval]]," she says. Taras plays the [[trombone]], and his friend Ihor plays the [[tuba]]. A small girl plays the [[piccolo]] very high. Ihor's brother plays [[sax]] in the back. "Sax is just short for [[saxophone]]," he tells a new boy. The new boy has a [[banjo]], and his sister has a [[ukulele]]. Another boy plays the [[bongos|bongo]] with his hands. At the end, the teacher hits a big [[gong]]. Everyone laughs, and the lesson is over.

c099.title: Dance lessons
c099.story: Anna and Max take dance lessons before cousin Olya's wedding. On Monday, they learn the [[tango]]. Max steps on Anna's foot twice. On Wednesday, they dance [[salsa]] and then [[samba]]. "We can dance this at the [[carnival]] in February!" says Anna. On Friday, the teacher shows them a fast [[polka]]. Max likes the [[boogie]] best. After class, they watch a [[ballet]] on TV. "A [[ballerina]] never steps on feet," Anna jokes. At the wedding, they dance a slow [[waltz]] first. Then they dance the [[mambo]] all night, and nobody falls.
